name: Onmyou Tantei Madoka Inma Gekitai Hen
original_name: 陰陽探偵まどか 淫魔撃退編
source:
The girl detective Madoka and her assistant Miku sneaked into the enemy's base to beat the incubus. Despite it was supposed to be a easy mission, they ends up violated by numerous number of tentacles.
